name: quorum
description: Run your Claude Code agents as a real team. Your editor session is the lead; specialist agents message each other, debate, decide and remember — visualized live on a desktop canvas. Built only on documented interfaces, runs entirely on your Claude subscription (no API costs).

scripts.dev: npm run build:main && concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:renderer" "npm:dev:electron"
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.start: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE QUORUM_PROD=1 electron .
scripts.start:demo: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE QUORUM_PROD=1 QUORUM_NO_SESSIONS=1 electron .
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron-builder --mac
